user.title: New door
user.description: Give the door a name. Everything else – doorbell button, camera, opener, notifications – is set up afterwards on the **Doorbell** page in the sidebar.

create_entry.first_door:
Door created.

**Next:** [set up the door now]({url}) – doorbell button, camera, opener and notifications are on the **Doorbell** page in the sidebar.

Nothing else is needed, no restart. Only devices on which Home Assistant was already open before this (e.g. a wall tablet) have to reload the page once; in the app, close it completely once and open it again.

show.name: Show live view
show.description: Opens the live view on all open Home Assistant pages.

loader_missing.title: Portier: please add one line to configuration.yaml
loader_missing.description:
Portier could not change your `configuration.yaml` safely (e.g. `frontend:` comes from `!include`). Without this line the live view does not appear on pages opened while Home Assistant starts (e.g. after a power cut).

Please add under `frontend:` by hand:

```yaml
frontend:
  extra_module_url:
    - {url}
```

It takes effect at the next start of Home Assistant.
